title: Studio metadata editor page: the flow node inspector on /studio/PKG/metadata/flow/NAME is read-only with no reason, because ResourceEditPage folds three causes into formReadOnly and passes no readOnlyReason
body:
domain:ui#1 · zhuangjianguo · session_01QsR2jUJ19MstFvFhjgiYTu

Filing gate: ② out-of-scope finding, class a, from the #28985 os-dev-report (PR #29073, report 6571078597) · filed by `domain:ui#1` · ⛔ Not a claim. No grade: triage sets it.

**Business reason.** A flow also opens on the metadata editor page (`/studio/PKG/metadata/flow/NAME`, `ResourceEditPage`). There the node inspector can be read-only for three different reasons: the user cannot write, a walled decision is pending, or the page is in view mode and not editing yet. After #28985 the Studio flow canvas explains its read-only state, but this page still greys the inspector with no reason, and each cause needs its own sentence (view mode should point at "Edit", not at switching packages).

**Measured (`origin/main` `6b3ba82cbb`, source reading; NOT MEASURED at a public door).**
- `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/ResourceEditPage.tsx:2571`: `formReadOnly = readOnly || walledDeciding || (!editing && !createMode)`, passed as `readOnly` to the inspectors (`:3468`, `:3492`, `:3511`, `:3525`, `:3553`) with no reason.
- PR #29073 adds `readOnlyReason?: string` to `MetadataInspectorProps`; `FlowNodeInspector` draws the described group only when a host passes it.

**Wanted.**
1. `ResourceEditPage` passes a `readOnlyReason` that names the cause in force: no write access, a pending walled decision, or view mode (with the way to start editing).
2. The inspectors that honor `readOnlyReason` show it; others are unchanged. No new metadata key or option; new UI strings go through the i18n packs.

**Tests.** Each of the three causes shows its own sentence on the node inspector; an editable page shows none. A test that fails on `main`.

**Reader.** `domain:ui`. Size S to M. Waits for PR #29073 (#28985) to land.

**Dedupe.** Searched `ResourceEditPage read-only reason`, `FlowEdgeInspector`: only #28985 and unrelated closed cards.

Links back: #28985, PR #29073.
